selectedOriginals.caption: Clevedon Pier, from the seafront, near sunset.
selectedOriginals.inspection: 2008 original individually inspected: full eight-arch slender dark iron pier silhouette, continuous flat deck/benches, spherical lamps at support stations, raised central pagoda and two low side shelters. Backlit view does not resolve fine material colors.

selectedOriginals.caption: Clevedon Pier from Toll House, showing boards and seating.
selectedOriginals.inspection: 2007 original individually inspected: grey longitudinal planks, full-length timber seats/backrests, dark tapered lamps with cream globe/cage; two low green glazed shelters flank raised pagoda on broad angled head. Central upper room above open lower structure and stair; concrete landing stage is separate below.

additionalInspected.caption: Clevedon Pier
additionalInspected.inspection: 2009 original individually inspected: eight slender repeated arched spans with radiating struts and double raked trestles/cross ties, teal side girder, grey weathered benches/deck; piers pass into water, not eight solid masonry arches. Own shore abutment separate from rock and neighboring buildings.

additionalInspected.caption: The pavilion at the end of Clevedon Pier
additionalInspected.inspection: 2008 original individually inspected: two-storey central green/cream pavilion, upper glazed room with amber clerestory, white ornamental wraparound balcony and diagonal external stair, curved flared four-sided roof/lower crown and pyramidal cap/vane. Lower stair to landing stage remains an actual void.

additionalInspected.caption: Structural support view
additionalInspected.sourceFamily: commons:clevedon pier support leg at lower tide.jpg
additionalInspected.inspection: 2013 original individually inspected: paired raked steel rails and riveted connecting plate above rounded cast-concrete/iron foundation foot visible at low tide. Rust/fastener distribution simplified, not a structural survey.

additionalInspected.caption: View of support structure from end of Pier
additionalInspected.inspection: 2013 original individually inspected: continuous teal flat side girder with repeated vertical stiffeners, longitudinal weathered timber bench backs and dark raked/cross-braced trestles. Distant tollhouse and neighboring hotel remain distinct.

additionalInspected.filename: Clevedon Pier, view towards the renovation of the Royal Hotel.JPG
additionalInspected.caption: North bench towards the toll house.
additionalInspected.sourceFamily: commons:clevedon pier, view towards the renovation of the royal hotel.jpg
additionalInspected.inspection: 2013 original individually inspected: tapered black lamp, cream globe with black vertical cage and crest, grey long plank deck/bench with small varied brass plaques. Actual plaque names not copied.

additionalInspected.caption: North View of Clevedon Pier from nearby hill, Somerset, England
additionalInspected.inspection: 2013 original individually inspected: long open trestle supports, wider head on closely spaced vertical columns and angled lower concrete landing stage/fender posts. Low tide gives relative scale, not bathymetric depths.

remoteSupplement.inspection: 2009 supplementary original individually inspected: small narrow rough sandstone tollhouse with roll strings, two-storey rectangular body, chamfered landward end, taller crenellated corner turret, thin white transomed rectangular windows and rock-faced lower foundation. Neighbouring larger gabled hotel is excluded; vegetation/rock are not building geometry.

sources.inspection: Official designation read: eight nominal100ft arched spans with radiating struts/raked stanchions/tie rods, lamps over supports, continuous wood benches, wider angled head with three cast-iron/glass shelters, central two-storey pagoda over landing-stage stairs, external first-floor stair/balcony, sandstone narrow crenellated tollhouse and globe entrance gates.

Operator history read: deliberate openwork iron design using discarded Barlow rails,1893 head/landing stage angled to current,24 iron columns/42 historic timber piles,1894 central pagoda/two shelters,1913 replacement concrete landing structure. Historical840ft proposal is not current overall footprint.

Operator2021 project article read: lower pagoda originally an open double stairway to landing stages; removable deck-level Bell Room floor proposed for2022. Selected2007–2013 surviving reference era predates this addition.
Society history read: eight nominal100ft arches and historical842ft length conflict with current mapped280m neck and roughly310m total envelope/story312m; recorded, not silently equated.

Aerial inspected in background browser at two zooms: long narrow deck northwest from shore, angled broad head with three separate shelters, narrow lower landing strip and distinct shore tollhouse south of entrance. Nearby Royal Pier Hotel and2016 shore Glass Box are separate from selected2007–2013 scope.

scope: Slender iron pier with eight open arched spans, timber deck/benches, globe lamps, angled column-supported head, raised pagoda/two shelters, lower landing stage and sandstone tollhouse.
limitations: Selected2007–2013 surviving exterior before2016 Glass Box and later removable Bell Room infill; not a claim to reproduce all2026 additions. Fine iron profiles, roof curves/ornament, exact support station spacing, buried pile depths, hidden tollhouse walls and individual windows are proportional estimates.

Independent map measures neck280.21m, widthabout6.27m and angled headabout28x14m; published nominal eight100ft arches imply243.84m and society historical842ft differs from current map/story312m total. Preserve current mapped footprint with eight equal estimated35m station intervals; exact construction chainages unverified.

Tidal range, seabed, pile embedment and concrete landing levels are not surveyed. Fixed representative stairs/landing stage and support depth are visual approximations. Independent native terrain remains unchanged and placement requires separate current contact review; footprint replacement disabled.

Neighboring Royal Pier Hotel, streets/rock/beach/sea/boats, temporary flags, people, sculpture/furniture beyond integral benches/lamps and interior exhibits excluded. No source photograph/plan pixels redistributed.
